messages:
Mara: quick q — we have a customer asking for bulk audit exports daily (full tenant history). bandwidth + privacy concerns. can we add metadata to the export bundle so consumers can decide what to download?
Jason: +1 metadata is useful. what fields are you thinking? size, row_count, redaction_level?
Mara: exactly. also need an explicit consent flag (whether tenant requested PII redaction) and a generated_by field so we know if it was a on-demand export vs scheduled job.
Priya: do we want to expose sampling info too? some teams want a compact 'preview' before pulling the full NDJSON.
Sam: preview sounds helpful. propose: preview.json with 100 rows + manifest.json with: {"sample_count":"int","total_count":"int","redaction_mode":"string","export_type":"scheduled|on-demand","generated_by":"string","schema_version":"v2"}
Ethan: caveat: manifest leaking actor ids could be a PII vector. manifest must avoid real actor identifiers unless redaction_mode=none and tenant consented.
Mara: agreed. manifest should include abstracted actor counts and a flag "actor_pseudonymization": "none|pseudonymized|hashed"
Jason: rollout plan? this touches API, console UX, telemetry and billing/quota checks. We should feature-flag it: audit_export_manifest_v2 behind FF.
Priya: console UX: show small card with export metadata and a "Download preview" CTA. default to preview, then require checkbox "I acknowledge this export contains non-redacted PII" when redaction_mode=none.
Sam: for API shape: GET /v1/exports/:id/manifest -> returns manifest + links to preview and full bundle (signed S3 urls). Example snippet:
```
GET /v1/exports/1234/manifest
200 {
  "sample_count": 100,
  "total_count": 184532,
  "redaction_mode": "pseudonymized",
  "actor_pseudonymization": "hashed",
  "export_type": "on-demand",
  "generated_by": "console:ui-exports-v1",
  "bundle": {"preview": "s3://.../preview.ndjson", "full": "s3://.../full.ndjson.zip"}
}
```
Ethan: add telemetry events: audit.export.preview_clicked, audit.export.full_requested, audit.export.consent_acknowledged. include export_id, tenant_id (hashed), manifest_schema_version. keep sizes for billing: bytes_preview, bytes_full_estimate.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag "audit_export_manifest_v2" will be gated to canary 5 tenants at 2024-11-04T15:00Z.
Jason: quota handling — do we allow full exports to bypass per-minute API quotas? probably not. we should route full downloads through the export worker queue and decrement a daily export_bandwidth quota per tenant.
Mara: +1. add manifest fields: estimated_full_bytes, export_bandwidth_cost_units. console should show estimated wait and quota impact.
Priya: regarding retention: manifest should include export_generation_time and snapshot_range: {"from":"2022-01-01T00:00Z","to":"2024-11-03T23:59Z"}. That clarifies what was captured.
Sam: any thoughts on format? zip vs streaming NDJSON? streaming is cheaper but harder for redaction at scale. we can keep full as zipped NDJSON for now and support streamed endpoints later.
Ethan: security: signed URLs expiry should be short for preview (1h) and longer for full (24h) but only if tenant feature flag allows. log downloads to audit.telemetry with checksum.
Mara: next steps: outline API contract PR (Sam), console mockups (Priya), quota + billing changes (Jason), telemetry events list (Ethan). I'll coordinate rollout and docs.
Jason: timeline? can we target canary in 2 weeks?
Sam: API PR ready in 4 days if no blockers.
Priya: UX mockups by EOD next Tue.
Ethan: telemetry + infra hooks in 1 week.
Mara: ok i’ll create tracking ticket and link PRs. tagging @Jason @Sam @Priya for follow-ups. thanks all :thumbsup:
